messages:
alex: FYI — we've confirmed a clear p95 spike (~5-10%) on embeddings after the quant-kernel selector bump. Impacting hosted embeddings (eu1 + us-east). I have a hotfix PR that forces kernel to v1 and a quick rollout plan. Requesting expedited approval to skip standard 30m canary and do a 10m quickwindow + staged traffic shift. deploy-bot: created canary roll (canary-id: cb-5078). starting smoke + perf checks.
deploy-bot: smoke checks: PASS. sample inference checks OK.
samir: give me rollback steps and a quick why. ops-oncall: I'm oncall, can validate if we need to hold.
alex: rollback plan: 1) pin model selector back to auto (current) 2) run `kubectl -n inference set image service=redwood-inference:v2.1.2` 3) rollback canary via `deployctl rollback cb-5078` — should be sub 5m. Root cause: quant-kernel path selects a new matmul kernel that increases tail latency on longer context; reverting gives baseline perf.
maria: can we limit to eu1 first? +1 for expedited if we start eu1 only. tanya: +1 from infra if rollback is that simple and we keep traffic shift slow.
alex: plan: eu1 quickwindow (10m) -> check p95/traces -> us-east partial (30%) -> monitor 15m -> full. Will attach release note and regression test. Also will pin Dedicated pools for customers on reserved capacity to avoid noisy neighbors during shift.
samir: I want a one-liner release note we can ship with the deploy: "hotfix v2.1.3-hotfix: revert kernel selector to mitigate embeddings p95 regression". Also add a changelog bullet linking to the PR.
ops-oncall: oncall ran a small synthetic run, p95 returned to baseline on canary host. Share traces/links pls.
alex: link to perf dashboard: https://perf.redwood.internal/dashboards/5078 hotfix dashboard + sample trace  https://traces.redwood.internal/trace/abc123.
deploy-bot: canary perf: p50 baseline, p95 restored to baseline (eu1), error budget unaffected.
maria: +1 to promote in eu1. If eu1 green, I approve us-east partial.
tanya: I'll watch the rollout and can pause if we see error surface. Keep notif to #incidents if anything.
samir: +1 from me but require release note and changelog entry before final promote.
alex: added release note to PR and updated changelog. Release note: "v2.1.3-hotfix — reverts kernel selector that caused p95 latency regressions for embeddings; mitigates impact while we validate new kernel changes."
deploy-bot: promoting canary cb-5078 -> 30% us-east at 5078901385.
deploy-bot: promotion complete. health checks passing (30m window started).
ops-oncall: monitoring logs/traces, no regression seen at 30%.
maria: promote to 100% in eu1 and us-east after another 15m if stable.
tanya: noted — channel pinned with rollback cmds and owner: alex.
alex: thanks all. tagging compliance for release note retention. If anything pops we roll back with `deployctl rollback cb-5078` and notify oncall. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: roll completed to 100% at 5078901420.
samir: marking this approved and closing the hotfix thread. :white_check_mark:
